overview_description.description: BOLT is a UAE-based consultancy specializing in innovation program design and management, startup acceleration, and strategic events. Positioned as agile, multilingual experts in the region, BOLT partners with innovation leaders to design and execute high-impact programs that deliver measurable results. Bringing programme management, professional technical expertise, know-how and access to market as well as access to top experts to all events. Our mission is to drive innovation in the region by championing youth development, diversity & inclusion, and economic empowerment.
